interpretation: Under the stated host, image, NullRHI settings, fixed PWM publishers and IMU/LiDAR observers, four instances completed two 300 s runs, while one 6-instance and one 8-instance run each lost one process to SIGSEGV before the workload completed. This supports a conservative four-instance cap for this load; it does not prove a universal limit or a single root cause. Earlier failures reached the frequency deque path, while these failures reached a different game-state null read after ChangeState:0, so at least two failure sites are observed.
limitations: workload is synthetic fixed PWM, not a full training task
